caption: The drawing depicts a pair of light blue trousers centered within a rectangular frame on a cream-colored background. The trousers have a high waist with a double-buttoned fly and a waistband that features two visible buttons. There are two vertical pockets on each side with long, narrow flaps and button closures at the top. Both legs taper downward and are finished with cuffs at the ankles, each adorned with a row of small buttons along the outer seam. The lines of the drawing are soft and even, and the overall composition is simple and symmetrical, focusing entirely on the front view of the trousers. The drawing appears to be made with blue ink or watercolor, and there is a small signature in the lower right corner inside the rectangular frame.
title: Trousers
